title: What You Think Of It
label: ch:ml-opinion
canDo: I can say that something is good or bad, and say that I think so.

payoff.summary: From cold: the ending that lets a quality stand alone, the negative the book had been missing, and the opinion frame that needed no new grammar.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. Only two vocabulary items are new; the quoting marker and the thinking verb were paired in chapter 72, so the opinion frame is assembly rather than instruction.
